messages:
Taylor (CSM): Kicking off onboarding for Veloria — quick sync on stakeholders, success metrics, and deliverables. First 30d goals: prod-ready API integration, baseline p95 latency < 300ms, and 80%+ NLU pass rate on verification set. Who will own integration and SSO?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I can own integration. Planning a 2-week sprint for connector + 1 week for validation. Need their infra contact for allowlist and OIDC metadata.
Lena (Veloria PM): Hi all — Lena here. I'll coordinate infra with Aaron (infra lead). Add two product success metrics: search relevance uplift >= +10pp and first-prompt success rate >= 90%.
Aaron (Veloria Infra): Aaron — OIDC endpoint: https://auth.veloria.com/. We'll need Redwood egress IPs to open. Who from your side sends that?
Taylor (CSM): I'll send our allowlist. Proposed kickoff workshops: Technical deep-dive Thu 2024-03-30 10:00 PT, Product enablement Tue 2024-04-02 11:00 PT. Does that calendar work? :calendar:
Lena (Veloria PM): 30-Mar tech works for us. Please record the enablement session for our wider ops team.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): For validation please share sample prompt set + eval rubric by EOD Mon. I'll provision a sandbox env and ephemeral creds.
Taylor (CSM): Action items: 1) Ravi -> integration owner (solutions eng); 2) Lena -> share infra contact + sample prompt set; 3) Aaron -> provide OIDC metadata + confirm egress IPs; 4) Taylor -> schedule workshops, share allowlist, and create weekly Typeform feedback for pilot. Also flagging renewal risk: if pilot usage < 20% of committed throughput by day 30 we'll surface at the QBR.
DevDeployBot: deploy created: veloria-sandbox-env v1.0 (sandbox credentials pending) at 1729987730
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Got the deploy notice, thanks. Quick q: do we want prefix/KV caching enabled for the pilot? It reduces cost but can mask generation regressions.
Lena (Veloria PM): Let's start with caching OFF for the first 2 weeks so we can tune prompts and measure raw latency.
Taylor (CSM): Noted — caching off for initial validation. I'll open a shared acceptance-criteria doc and post link here after this thread. Also tagging onboarding checklist: integration test, latency bench, relevance eval, support rotation, enablement recorded, feedback survey.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll upload initial test logs to the sandbox folder and share curl examples:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBOX_KEY"
  -d '{"input":"<sample prompt>"}'
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Lena (Veloria PM): Perfect. Expecting sample prompts + rubric by tomorrow EOD. Thanks everyone — looking forward to kicking off.
Taylor (CSM): Thanks — I'll follow up with calendar invites and the Typeform link. :thumbsup:
